description: This file defines a NestJS controller for managing verified resources (emails and phone numbers) for teams, including requesting verification codes, verifying codes, and retrieving verified resource data.

classes.name: TeamsVerifiedResourcesController
classes.description: NestJS controller handling team verified resources, including email and phone verification requests, verification, and retrieval.

methods.name: requestEmailVerificationCode
methods.description: Handles request to send email verification code to a team member.

methods.name: requestPhoneVerificationCode
methods.description: Handles request to send phone verification code.

methods.name: verifyEmail
methods.description: Verifies a team's email using a provided code.

methods.name: verifyPhoneNumber
methods.description: Verifies a team's phone number using a provided code.

methods.name: getVerifiedEmails
methods.description: Retrieves list of verified emails for a team.

methods.name: getVerifiedPhoneNumbers
methods.description: Retrieves list of verified phone numbers for a team.

methods.name: getVerifiedEmailById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific verified email by ID.

methods.name: getVerifiedPhoneById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific verified phone number by ID.
